sources.title: Lucasgitguy-co/forma3d-tiny · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Forma3D-Tiny v0.2 An experimental compact image-to-Gaussian model post-trained from Image3D Student's synthetic demonstration checkpoint. This is a coarse research baseline, not a general-purpose photo-to-3D model. Its grid is 16 cubed and it has 306,321 parameters. Selected checkpoint: step 4800; completed run: 5000 steps.

sources.title: GitHub - lukethehawk/Forma3D
sources.snippet: Forma3D is an STL editor for small 3D-printing model edits. It runs locally as an Electron app and also as a GitHub Pages web app. Files are handled in the browser/app: the workflow is designed around direct mesh editing, not uploading models to external services. Before changing code, read the development diary. It documents architecture, mesh logic, known limits and design decisions.
